resolved_by: The 2024 amendment to U.S.S.G. § 2K2.1(b)(4)(B) limited the obliterated-serial-number enhancement to serial numbers that are "illegible or unrecognizable to the unaided eye," resolving the split. The Commission did not make the amendment retroactive.
issue: Does the obliterated serial number enhancement apply to firearms whose serial numbers are less legible but not completely obliterated?

sides.position: The enhancement applies to serial numbers that are 'less legible,' not only to those that are completely obliterated.
cases: United States v. Harris, 720 F.3d 499 (4th Cir. 2013)

sides.position: The enhancement applies only to 'illegible' serial numbers.
cases: United States v. St. Hilaire, 960 F.3d 61 (2d Cir. 2020)

quote: Prior to 2024, the federal circuit courts of appeals were of differing views regarding whether this Guideline enhancement applied to less-than-legible serial numbers that were not completely obliterated.
cite: United States v. Bisheem Jones, No. 23-4711 (4th Cir. 2026)
